body: try that with "--disable copy" and see if it works.
"--disable copy" works fine, but I would prefer the copying be server sided since my upload speed is very slow.

This looks like the same issue I contributed to just earlier - There seems to be an issue with rclone copying big files server-side. The google API itself seems to allow it, so it looks like an rclone problem.

https://github.com/ncw/rclone/issues/3070

In my case that server side copy only fails in the vps of contabo... so it seems that contabo or google are having communication issues i think.

the same command with same config in another server works (in this case the other server is a dedi not a vps as the failing ones)
Do both servers have the same rclone version?
sure looks like the vps peering with a backend that has issues.

rclone Version Details:
rclone v1.47.0
- os/arch: windows/386 and 64(tested both)
- go version: go1.11

A bit of my own input, rclone 1.47 on Windows seems to never really start and the process kind of lingers on checks and starts producing these 500/503 errors. If I use the same config on Ubuntu 18.04(haven't tested any other yet), no issues with errors and server side copies work as expected.

I don't believe this to be an issue with quota or peering. Another community member(elsewhere) was having the same issues, a few people were trying to troubleshoot it and another member was able to connect to the problematic drive of the account owner and did not have issues on his machine. It wasn't until my issue that I realized it might be an issue with rclone/build

1.46 on Windows seems to not have the issue, however wasn't allowing server side copies.

Also, if the directory is relatively small it seems to sequentially copy through the files fine, but even modestly medium size directories are exhibiting this issue. File size does not seem to matter. 

I can post some logs if someone wants to instruct me on what they'd like to see. Otherwise, I just thought I'd chime in.

It seems likely that this is the same issue as #3070 

I wrote there: I'm not sure what to do about this.  It seems to be a problem at the google drive end.  Rclone uses the [v3 copy API](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/v3/reference/files/copy) and nowhere in that is mention of file size limits.

I suspect it is an internal timeout when copying the very large file.

I believe the info here may be relevant. Been looking through the available documentation and I don't know if they updated it or if I just stumbled upon some alternate reality.

https://developers.google.com/drive/api/v3/reference/files/create
Thanks a925sw, server side copies seem to be working as intended on Ubuntu 18.04.
